notes: Read all three units, student-debt context, all seven candidates and the review. Limited the eligibility rule to predatory for-profit programs, named the U.S. Secretary of Education while preserving the call-upon modality, and restored both the once-again temporal qualification on alleged predation and the domestic-strength-and-unity prerequisite for strength abroad.

claims.claim_text: The platform says repeal of protections once again allowed for-profit colleges and universities to prey on students with impunity.
Democrats would require predatory for-profit higher-education programs to demonstrate value and effectiveness before receiving federal-student-loan eligibility.
Democrats would call on the U.S. Secretary of Education to forgive debt of students defrauded or misled by predatory schools.
Democrats would call on the U.S. Secretary of Education to forgive debt held by permanently disabled people.
Democrats believe U.S. strength abroad requires strength and unity at home.
